prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative of your company.

We ask that you provide the policy limits for all coverages applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page, so that we can evaluate the claim properly. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle inspection reports, recorded statements, claim notes, and any other materials in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such records while the claim is pending. We look forward to your prompt written response.
